sources.full: Bronze Dragon Wyrmling — Classic 5e Campaign Import

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons. Both options share this recharge.

entries.name: Lightning Breath
entries: The dragon exhales lightning in a 40-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 ({@damage 3d10}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Repulsion Breath
entries: The dragon exhales repulsion energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be pushed 30 feet away from the dragon.
A campaign import of the classic 2014 fifth-edition Bronze Dragon Wyrmling stat block. Statistics are unchanged; no portrait or token artwork is included.
